description: A time-of-day field: the native <input type="time"> in the system's Input clothes, so the picker, the validation and the keyboard stay the browser's. The value is always 24-hour "HH:MM"; the browser shows it in the user's own clock convention. Wrap it in <Field> for its label, like <Input>.

props.name: value
props.description: 24-hour "HH:MM" (the native time value). Empty string = not set yet.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which surface the field sits on; same contract as <Input>.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: sm / md (default) / lg — matches the button/control scale.

example:
const [start, setStart] = useState('09:30')

<TimeInput aria-label="Starts at" value={start} onChange={setStart} />
